title: Benchmarking Quantum Kernel SVMs for Credit Card Fraud Detection: Performance Realities Under NISQ Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2610.17027v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Detecting credit card fraud is notoriously difficult because fraudulent charges make up less than 0.2% of total transactions. Quantum Machine Learning (QML), particularly Quantum Kernel Support Vector Machines (QSVM), promises richer feature representations by embedding classical data into high-dimensional Hilbert spaces. However, whether this theoretical advantage holds up when managing real-world financial data bottlenecks remains unclear. We designed a controlled benchmark comparing three quantum encodings, Angle, ZZFeatureMap, and IQP against classical models while keeping sample sizes, feature counts, and scaling strictly matched. To handle class skew without corrupting quantum state overlaps, we embedded synthetic minority oversampling (SMOTE) directly into the quantum Gram matrix workflow, raising PR-AUC scores by roughly +0.04 across feature maps. translated_title: 面向信用卡欺诈检测的量子核支持向量机基准测试：NISQ约束下的性能现实
translated_abstract: 检测信用卡欺诈是出了名的困难，因为欺诈交易在总交易中的占比不足0.2%。量子机器学习（QML），尤其是量子核支持向量机（QSVM），通过将经典数据嵌入高维希尔伯特空间，有望提供更丰富的特征表示。然而，这种理论优势在应对真实世界金融数据瓶颈时是否依然成立，目前尚不清楚。我们设计了一个受控基准测试，将三种量子编码——Angle、ZZFeatureMap和IQP——与经典模型进行对比，并严格保持样本量、特征数量和缩放方式一致。为了在不破坏量子态重叠的情况下处理类别偏斜问题，我们将合成少数类过采样技术（SMOTE）直接嵌入到量子格拉姆矩阵工作流中，使各特征图的PR-AUC分数提升了约+0.04。当在包含30个特征的完整欧洲信用卡数据集上训练时，经典模型……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 本文构建了严格受控的基准测试，对比Angle、ZZFeatureMap和IQP三种量子核编码与经典模型在信用卡欺诈检测上的表现，并创新性地将SMOTE过采样直接嵌入量子格拉姆矩阵计算流程，在不破坏量子态保真度的前提下提升了约0.04的PR-AUC，以检验量子优势在NISQ现实约束下是否成立。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a strictly controlled benchmark comparing three quantum kernel encodings (Angle, ZZFeatureMap, and IQP) against classical models for credit card fraud detection, and innovatively embeds SMOTE oversampling directly into the quantum Gram matrix pipeline, improving PR-AUC by roughly +0.04 while testing whether quantum advantage holds under real-world NISQ constraints.
